name: Asato Anri
source:
Second oldest sister of family. Is the most normal of siblings getting along with everyone. Protag believes she is secretly a slut due to how she dresses and acts.

[spoiler] She original believed she was the adopted child in family. Because of this she never saw the protag as brother and had no problems having sexual relationship with him. [/spoiler]
